description: Send pacing refused the send (opt-in, SEND_PACING_ENABLED=true): 429 WITH a `code` and `retryAfterSeconds` (hours possible). The plain throttler 429 has no code (see ratelimit-throttled, recorded).

body.message: Daily allowance of 5 new conversation(s) reached for a session 0 day(s) old

notes: Do not retry before retryAfterSeconds. Honour the `Retry-After` header when present.
